title: Buchtel vs. Firestone — Football (2025–2026)
summary: Buchtel Griffins vs. Firestone Falcons — 2025–2026 high school football coverage in Akron, Ohio. Photography by Mason Bybee.
article_headline: Buchtel vs. Firestone: Akron Football in Focus
article_dek: A visual record of the Griffins and Falcons competing during the 2025 season.
article_body:
For Buchtel and Firestone, high school football is also about representing their neighborhoods, teammates and schools. Each possession adds another moment to the shared history of Akron athletics.

Mason Bybee’s photography brings this meeting into focus through the movement, contact and sideline details of the game. This is an archival photo feature rather than an unverified play-by-play.
